ns2:course.label: Financial Management
ns2:course.description: Introduction to financial management and decision making. Topics include risk-return relationships for financial securities; financial statement analysis and forecasting; working capital management; capital budgeting and the resource allocation process; capital structure and the cost of capital; dividend policy. Prerequisite: Enrollment in the Executive MBA, MSBA, or MS program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Enrollment in the Executive MBA, MSBA, or MS program.
